_source_note: Fully rebuilt (2nd pass, Sept 2026) from 35 real in-game tooltip screenshots pulled directly from Ascension by Kyle (Priimalist.docx). Major corrections: Geode Barrage is 10 Mana/16 Physical dmg at Rank 1 (was modeled with Nature-ish flavor and higher numbers); Wildclaw is 30 Rage (was 20); Earthquake is Lvl 16 and a Nature DoT+slow (was Lvl 10 flat Physical AoE); Hand of the Earthmother is Lvl 6 (was 4); Mountain Hammer moved to Mountain King spec tree (was wrongly class-wide) and corrected to Lvl 26. Added the Seismic spell family (Geode Barrage/Seismic Crash/Seismic Spike/Seismic Tremor/Seismic Wave, shared cooldown), the Boon family (Turtle/Bear/Wolf/Hawk/Lion, mutually exclusive via exclusive_group), and the Instinct family (Grove/Primal, mutually exclusive). Rank-1 starting-ability values from this batch supersede the earlier session's guessed numbers.

UNIT FIX 2026-10-29, and this was THE Mountain King bug. This was authored as -10, read by a note claiming ability-buff stat_mods are percent points. For this key they are NOT: Character.take_damage does `taken_mult = 1.0 + get_talent_effect('damage_taken_pct')` then `taken_mult += get_status_stat_mod('damage_taken_pct')` with NO /100, unlike its school-specific sibling physical_damage_taken_pct a few lines down, which IS divided. So -10 meant -1000% damage taken: taken_mult went to -9 and every landed hit floored at 1. Boon has cooldown 0 and duration 30, so the buff is up permanently, which is correct for a Boon and is what made the spec immortal rather than merely strong. 41 of the 51 abilities in the game that carry this key already author it as a fraction (warrior_shield_wall -0.4, druid_barkskin -0.2); this now matches them and the engine. -10% as CoA states.

abilities.name: Boon of the Hawk
abilities.description: Increase your spell haste, reduce ability costs, and regenerate health over time. Only 1 Boon may be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6, '+12% spell haste, -10% spell/ability cost, regenerate 1% max health every 5 sec.' Part of the Boon family.  DEAD STAT KEY CORRECTED: 'cost_reduction_pct' is read by nothing in the engine; the live key is all_ability_cost_pct. Verified by applying each as a status stat_mod and reading the stat back.  AND THE VALUE: 10 was written for the dead key as percent POINTS, but all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION - talented_cost computes cost * (1 - pct) and clamps at 0.90, so 10 read as -1000% and clamped to a 90% discount: Geode Barrage went from 11 to 1. Renaming the key without converting the value traded a dead effect for a wrong one, which is worse. Now 0.10, i.e. the 10% the description means.

abilities.name: Mountain Hammer
abilities.description: Throw a hammer at an enemy, dealing Physical damage and stunning them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Mountain King-locked (was wrongly class-wide), Lvl 26 (was 20), '80 Physical damage and stunning them for 5 sec.'  Removed dead flag stat_mod(s) ['stunned']: nothing in the engine reads them. The real mechanism is the ability-level is_stun flag, which this ability already carries. Keeping them was the is_aoe trap waiting to happen: data that looks like the mechanism and is not. This engine has exactly one incapacitate mechanic, is_stun, with no separate silence or root category (see StatusEffect.is_stun).

abilities.name: Rock Barrier
abilities.description: Armor Pct +30%, Physical damage taken -8% for 3 turns, absorbing damage.
abilities._source: Added 2026-10-28 on Kyle's direction to follow the CoA reference. CoA's Mountain King survives on these two and Frontier had neither - the audit found five Mountain King talents referencing Rock Barrier while no primalist_rock_barrier ability existed at all. Removing the spec's invented self-heal procs left it with no sustain and no cooldown, 5 turns alive against a field of 5-21; these are the real tools that gap was asking for. CONVENTION, CORRECTED 2026-10-29: this ability's own values were right and the reasoning written beside them was wrong, so it is restated here because it is the trap that broke the spec. There is no single rule for ability-buff stat_mods - it is per key. armor_pct and physical_damage_taken_pct, both used here, ARE percent points (character.py divides armor_pct by 100 folding bonuses into armour, and take_damage divides get_status_stat_mod('physical_damage_taken_pct') by 100). The school-agnostic damage_taken_pct is NOT - take_damage adds it to taken_mult undivided, so it is a fraction there. The old note generalised from primalist_boon_of_the_turtle's -10, which was itself the bug. CoA: a reactive charge-based armour shield, referenced by Earthmother's Protection, Fury of the Earthmother, Earthenforged Barrier, Rock Solid and Primal Guardian. Charges have no engine shape, so it is a short buff carrying armour, physical mitigation and a real absorb.

abilities.name: Earthen Avatar
abilities.description: Take the shape of the earth itself: slower to fall, quicker to strike, and harder to move.
abilities._source:
Added 2026-10-28 on Kyle's direction to follow the CoA reference. CoA's Mountain King survives on these two and Frontier had neither - the audit found five Mountain King talents referencing Rock Barrier while no primalist_rock_barrier ability existed at all. Removing the spec's invented self-heal procs left it with no sustain and no cooldown, 5 turns alive against a field of 5-21; these are the real tools that gap was asking for. CoA: 'increasing your damage dealt and reducing your damage taken by 15%, and increasing your attack speed by 20% for 20 seconds. Immune to stuns, roots, and snares. Usable while stunned.' CoA calls it 'your big cooldown'. The immunity clause has no hook; Unmovable Object in the same tree already shortens stuns.

UNIT FIX 2026-10-29: damage_taken_pct was -15 under a note claiming ability-buff stat_mods are percent points for this key. They are not - see primalist_boon_of_the_turtle's note and Character.take_damage, where get_status_stat_mod('damage_taken_pct') is added to taken_mult undivided while physical_damage_taken_pct IS divided by 100. -15 meant -1500%, flooring every hit at 1 damage for the buff's whole window. Now -0.15, the 15% CoA's own tooltip states. The sibling keys on this ability are unchanged and were already right: armor_pct and haste ARE points (character.py divides armor_pct by 100 when folding bonuses into armour).
